valores.label: Gold found at Gold Creek; the mining camp that became Juneau

legenda: Juneau began as a gold-mining camp in 1880.
credito_tela: Source: City and Borough of Juneau
nota: A página da CBJ não tem data (reproduz Ferrell, 1995, e o guia de 1999): o crédito sai sem ano, ou com o do texto, decisão do redator-de-tela. O 1880 é de tela (a voz não dá ano) e confere.
narracao: The city began as a gold camp.

conferencia.localizador: The Founding of Juneau (Ferrell); A Short History of Juneau
conferencia.prova: "A day after the discovery–October 4, 1880–the miners wrote a 'Code of Local Laws'"; "On October 18–Alaska Day–the men blocked out a 160-acre townsite on the beach"; o texto chama o lugar de 'the mining camp'
